name: Auto Eder
verdict: Auto Eder GmbH is a family-led Bavarian car-dealer group; its managing partners are Peter Eder and Josef Eder. Nothing found.
note: Rating note (issue #603, 2026-09-29): family business; no state in the chain and no human-rights finding found. Auto Eder also gives its name to the team's junior squad, grenke - Auto Eder.
